description: Renovate covers the default container images, the base image of each Dockerfile, the Go toolchain, and golangci-lint. Dependabot keeps the Go modules and the actions.
The schedule is weekly, so one batch of updates arrives on one day. The shared presets set no schedule.

customManagers.description: The container images a RedisFailover runs when it names none of its own. Each constant holds a tag and the digest it resolves to, and both move together.

packageRules.description: Dependabot keeps the Go modules, so renovate proposes nothing else out of go.mod.

The Go toolchain moves as one piece: the directive in go.mod and the builder image in both Dockerfiles. Every test job reads its Go version from go.mod. A builder image that moved alone would compile the operator with one toolchain and test it with another. The directive declares a minimum, so bump raises it rather than leaving it satisfied by a newer Go.
golangci-lint reads what the Go toolchain compiles, and a release older than the toolchain fails the lint job. It joins the toolchain group so that an update to both arrives in one pull request.
One pull request for a round of default image updates. A digest that moves under an unchanged tag is a rebuilt image, and it rides along rather than opening a pull request of its own.

Redis holds the minor it serves. Redis 7.4 carries a different license, RSALv2 or SSPLv1 rather than BSD-3-Clause, and it writes a snapshot format that 7.2 cannot read back. Moving off this minor is a decision of its own, not one line of an image round.
